# Water bucket

[All items](Items.md) · [Crafting guide](Crafting-Recipes.md) · [Home](Home.md)

[How to obtain](#how-to-obtain) · [Crafting and processing](#crafting-and-processing)

<a href="Item-water-bucket.md" title="Water bucket"><img src="icons/95.png" width="96" height="96" alt="Water bucket"></a>

A bucket holding one water source, equivalent to **10 L**.

## At a glance

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Stack size | 1 |

## How to obtain

Use an empty [Bucket](Item-bucket.md) on source water, or remove 10 L through a filled machine’s bucket controls. This is a fluid transfer, not a grid recipe.

## Using it

Use it to place source water in the world, or add 10 L through a boiler or tank interface. Emptying it returns a [Bucket](Item-bucket.md). See the [renewable pool guide](Pumps-and-water.md).

## Crafting and processing

There is no registered crafting or processing recipe for this item. Use the acquisition method above.
